rules.cancellation_rebooking: Free rebooking on the next available flight within 24 hours, or a full refund, customer’s choice.
rules.delay_over_5: Meal voucher + hotel accommodation covering only the delayed hours, not a full night
rules.refund: Full refund within 7 business days to the original payment method only.
rules.fare_difference: Customer pays fare difference for voluntary higher-fare rebooking. Agents cannot waive amounts above ₹1,500 without supervisor approval.
rules.loyalty: Gold and Platinum receive priority rebooking, with no extra compensation beyond standard policy.

allowed_actions: Rebook on next available flight within 24 hours at no charge for airline-caused cancellation
Issue meal vouchers and lounge access per delay rule
Arrange hotel accommodation for the delayed-hours portion when qualified
Initiate refund request for airline-caused cancellation
Provide customer's own booking and flight status
prohibited_actions: Approve compensation beyond stated policy amounts
Handle threats of legal action or formal complaints; escalate immediately
Process refunds to a different payment method
